# jumpcloud_durt_settings (Resource)

Manages JumpCloud's org-wide "JumpCloud Go" (DURT) factor configuration. Built from a captured browser request against JumpCloud's "MFA Configurations" admin page -- not documented anywhere else.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether JumpCloud Go (DURT) is enabled org-wide. Destroying this resource resets it to false.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
